title: Disconnected punctured spectra of completions and henselizations
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof encodes a disconnected completed punctured spectrum by two ideals with nilpotent product and finite-length conormal data. It algebraizes a quotient, uses henselian etale localization to descend its ideal, and reconstructs the disconnected decomposition before completion.
